cases.prompt: Our blog shows a newsletter modal 3 seconds after page load on every visit, desktop and mobile. The close control is an unlabeled 12px icon and keyboard focus stays behind the modal. Redesign it so engaged readers can subscribe without hurting reading.

requiredEvidence: engagement trigger instead of page load
forbiddenClaims: signups will rise with no annoyance cost
forbiddenActions: added a forced countdown before dismissal
